newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not established - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn cattle market not established - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not fully established, compared with Wednesday's close, USDA said. Trade was slow to moderate. Demand moderate. Seller interest light to moderate. Offerings light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 68.00-68.50. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1100-1200 lbs few 68.50.
On a carcass basis (weight only) slaughter steers and heifers were firm in a light test.
